name: The Maple Street Ramblers
description: Fiddle, banjo, and tight family harmonies on the front porch of the old green house.

name: Low Tide Trio
description: Three-part harmonies and fingerpicked guitars. Bring a folding chair.

name: Porch Light Brass
description: Six-piece street brass rolling through New Orleans standards and a few surprises.

name: Hey Mockingbird
description: Dusty-boot country with pedal steel and a pocket-sized horn section.

name: The Kitchen Window
description: Organ, drums, and a lead singer who will make the neighbors lean out their windows.

name: Saturday Sparrows
description: Four friends, two guitars, one cajón, and a set list you can sing along to.

name: Copper Kettle Jug Band
description: Washboard, jug, kazoo, upright bass. The only encore they take is for cornbread.
